Both addons are requested from the same NPC: the first costs 5 {item:Pomegranate|Pomegranates} and the second an {item:Ice Shield}, both loot from the Dream Scar bosses (the Ice Shield also drops from the Nightmare Beast) or bought on the Market. With both addons you earn the achievement **Dream Warrior**.

Base: when you report the {key:task} to {npc:Vanys} or {npc:Undal} after killing {creature:The Nightmare Beast}. Addons: when you hand 5 {item:Pomegranate|Pomegranates} (1st) and 1 {item:Ice Shield} (2nd) to the same NPC.
Gather the items **before** you go to the NPC: the {item:Pomegranate} and the {item:Ice Shield} are tradeable on the Market, and no NPC sells or buys them.
The {item:Pomegranate} is **not stackable**: the 5 take up 5 slots in your backpack (1.00 oz each). The {item:Ice Shield} weighs 35.00 oz.
{npc:Vanys} and {npc:Undal} give the same outfit and the same addons. The Court of Summer (Vanys), in Feyrist, is the easier one to reach.

To farm the Ice Shield, on Izcandar days kill him on the **west** side of the arena (the winter side): that way he dies as {creature:Izcandar Champion of Winter}, the only one of the daily champions that can drop the Ice Shield.
The base outfit cannot be bought: you only get it after you finish the Dream Courts Quest and kill the Nightmare Beast.

Complete {wiki:The Dream Courts Quest} (level 250, Premium). In short: you talk to {npc:Myzzi}, north-east of Edron, to get access to the courts; you charge the 8 Ward Stones with the {item:Dream Talisman}; you open the 7 Dream Doors of the {wiki:Dream Labyrinth}; you win 5 fights in the {wiki:Dream Scar}; and you kill {creature:The Nightmare Beast}. Follow that quest's guide for the details of each part.
Charge 4 Ice Ward Stones and 4 Sun Ward Stones with the {item:Dream Talisman} that Vanys or Undal gives you ({key:task}).
Solve the puzzles of the 7 Dream Doors (achievement **Keeper of the 7 Keys**).

5 victories against the champion of the day ({creature:Plagueroot}, {creature:Malofur Mangrinder}, {creature:Maxxenius}, {creature:Alptramun} and {creature:Izcandar the Banished}), in teams of up to 5 players.

Final boss, for teams of up to 10 players. One player gets cursed and is thrown out of the room after 25 seconds unless another player uses a {item:Dream Catcher} on them (taken from the {item:Dream Catcher Pole} in the centre of the room); you cannot heal yourself.
The Nightmare Beast cannot be done alone: the curse can only be removed by **another** player. You need a team to get the base outfit.
The Court of Summer is in the meadows of Feyrist and is the easiest court to reach. If you would rather go to Undal, in the Court of Winter, follow section 7.

Get a {item:Small Emerald}. In the city, go to the corridor with the four arches (ice, earth, fire and energy) that lead to the {wiki:Holy Shrines|Holy Shrines} (see the table). Enter the **earth** arch: you are taken to an earth shrine. **Use** the {item:Small Emerald} on the shrine there (the gem is consumed) and you are teleported to the Earth Shrine of Feyrist.

Entering the Court of Summer portal

The portal is **east** of the Earth Shrine, in the meadows north-east of the Fae Village ({coord:33584,32207,7}). Go there and enter the portal: with {npc:Myzzi}'s enchantment you pass into the Court of Summer.
Court of Summer portal (north-east of the Fae Village)
Fae Village, in the centre of Feyrist
Inside the court, go **north** until you find some stairs and go down one floor. {npc:Vanys} is on that underground floor.

Along the way you meet many {creature:Crazed Summer Rearguard|Crazed Summer Rearguards} and {creature:Crazed Summer Vanguard|Crazed Summer Vanguards}; the court also has {creature:Insane Siren|Insane Sirens}, {creature:Arachnophobica|Arachnophobicas} and {creature:Thanatursus}.

After you kill the Nightmare Beast, say {key:hi} and {key:task} to {npc:Vanys}. He confirms that the beast has been killed and gives you the base Dream Warrior Outfit, on behalf of the summer and winter courts.

Quick option: buy on the Market

Both items are tradeable. At any depot, open the {wiki:Market|Market}, search for {item:Pomegranate} and {item:Ice Shield} and buy 5 Pomegranates and 1 Ice Shield. Take them with you to Vanys (or Undal) and move on to section 5.
Reaching the Dream Scar (if you are going to farm)

The items drop from the {wiki:Dream Scar} bosses. In the Court of Summer, go back to the entrance floor and go up two floors to the {wiki:Dream Labyrinth} portal (next to the chest where the Rosebush was). Cross the labyrinth along the path you took in {wiki:The Dream Courts Quest}, through the 7 Dream Doors, to the room with a mosaic in the centre: the mosaic is the portal to the Dream Scar. In the arena, before each fight, talk to one of the two Dreamelves ({npc:Shirtalis of the Summer Court} or {npc:Farhilorn of the Winter Court}) and join their side to fight under their banner (the wiki has no transcript for these NPCs).
Next to the Dream Labyrinth portal (Court of Summer, 2 floors up)
Court of Summer: climb two floors to the Dream Labyrinth portal (next to the Rosebush chest)
Last room of the Dream Labyrinth: the mosaic in the centre leads to the Dream Scar
Each day (at every Server Save) there is a different champion in the arena, for teams of up to 5 players. They are very strong bosses: go as a team and prepare for the boss of the day.
The Court of Winter also has a portal to the Dream Labyrinth, if you are on Undal's side.
Any Dream Scar champion can drop **1** {item:Pomegranate} per kill. The percentages below are estimates from the wiki's loot statistics; expect several kills to gather 5.
{creature:Izcandar Champion of Summer} (dies in the east)
{creature:Izcandar Champion of Winter} (dies in the west)
The bosses always appear in this order, one per day: Plagueroot, Malofur Mangrinder, Maxxenius, Alptramun and Izcandar.

Only two bosses drop the {item:Ice Shield}: {creature:Izcandar Champion of Winter} (≈ 4.5%) and {creature:The Nightmare Beast} (≈ 6.8%). Izcandar changes form depending on where in the arena he dies: on the **west** side (winter) he becomes Champion of Winter; on the **east** side (summer) he becomes Champion of Summer; near the **centre** he stays Izcandar the Banished. The last two forms do not drop the shield, so on Izcandar days always finish him on the west side. The Nightmare Beast is beyond the teleport to the **south-west** of the Dream Scar arena (you can already go through it, since you have the 5 victories from the Dream Courts Quest); it is for teams of up to 10 players and has a 20-hour cooldown.
The winter form is weak to fire and heals from ice: do not use ice against it and wear ice protection. {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes} are a good single-target option.

When the fight is over, leave the boss room through the exit teleport there (the wiki does not say where it takes you). Then go back the same way: in the small mosaic room, the portal to the **south** takes you back to the Dream Labyrinth; cross the labyrinth to the Court of Summer (or Court of Winter) portal, enter it and, once in the court, go down the two floors to the entrance floor and then on to {npc:Vanys}.
The portal south of the mosaic room only works one way: after using it, to get back to the mosaic you have to retrace the labyrinth path on foot. Do not use it by mistake if you still want to fight.
The NPC asks which of the two items you are bringing, so you can hand in whichever one you already have first.

With the 5 {item:Pomegranate|Pomegranates} in your backpack, talk to {npc:Vanys}: {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:yes} (you want one or two addons), {key:yes} (you want one of these addons) and {key:pomegranate}.
2nd addon: handing in the Ice Shield

With the {item:Ice Shield} in your backpack, talk to {npc:Vanys} again: {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} and {key:shield}. Once you have both addons you get the achievement **Dream Warrior**.
2nd Dream Warrior addon + achievement Dream Warrior (with both addons)

Go up the stairs from Vanys's floor and head back **south** the way you came, to the spot where you arrived at the court. The wiki does not describe the way back from the Court of Summer to the meadows of Feyrist: look for it near that arrival point. Once in Feyrist, **use** any of the four Holy Shrines (it does not matter which one you came in through and you **do not need another gem**) and you are teleported back to the mainland.
If you cannot find the exit, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or while you have a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block).
Earth Shrine (the closest to the court)
7. Alternative: Undal in the Court of Winter
{npc:Undal} gives exactly the same outfit and the same addons as Vanys. Use this route if it is more convenient for you to set off from Svargrond.

Travel by boat to **Svargrond**. Go to the boat **south** of the city and talk to {npc:Buddel}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:tyrsung} (50 gp). You land at the {wiki:Tyrsung} pier ({coord:32332,31230,7}).

Buddel is always drunk and may take you to the wrong place. With a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack he takes you to the right destination and does not charge the 50 gp, but he keeps the ring. If you do not want to lose it, say {key:no} when he asks for it (or wear the ring in the ring slot, if you only have one).
Climbing to the top of the Tyrsung mountain

Go to the mountain in the centre of the island ({wiki:Jotunar|Jotunar}, the rock and ice mountain of the {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants}) and climb it via the points marked below, floor by floor, to the top (z=3, 4 floors above the ground). There you find the Court of Winter portal ({coord:32356,31248,3}). The wiki only gives these waypoints, without describing the path between them.
Map of Jotunar, the mountain in the centre of Tyrsung
Entering the Court of Winter and going to Undal
Enter the portal (with {npc:Myzzi}'s enchantment). In the Court of Winter, go to the **east** side and climb up to {npc:Undal}'s floor.

The court has {creature:Crazed Winter Rearguard|Crazed Winter Rearguards}, {creature:Crazed Winter Vanguard|Crazed Winter Vanguards} and {creature:Soul-Broken Harbinger|Soul-Broken Harbingers}, as well as {creature:Arachnophobica|Arachnophobicas} and {creature:Thanatursus}.

The spoiler says that the {key:task} and the {key:addon} can be done with Vanys **or** with Undal; the wiki only has Vanys's transcript, so use the same words: {key:hi} and {key:task} for the base outfit (after the Nightmare Beast); {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} and then {key:pomegranate} (5 Pomegranates) or {key:shield} (Ice Shield) for each addon.
Base outfit and addons, as with Vanys
Leaving the Court of Winter and Tyrsung

Go back the same way to the spot where you arrived at the court. The wiki does not describe the way back from the Court of Winter to the top of the Tyrsung mountain: look for it near that arrival point. Once in Tyrsung, go down the mountain via the same points, go to the pier and talk to {npc:Buddel}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} (Svargrond is one of his destinations, 50 gp) to return to the pier south of Svargrond.

On the way back, too, Buddel may take you to the wrong place; the {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack solves it, as on the way there. If you cannot find the exit from the court, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or while you have a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block).

The achievement **Dream Warrior** (6 points, Premium) only appears when you have **both** addons. Its description says you have come to know the dream courts and earned the right to the title of *dream warrior*.
Each step (base outfit, 1st addon and 2nd addon) can be done with {npc:Vanys} **or** with {npc:Undal}.
This outfit and its addons were added in the Winter Update 2018 (version 12.00).
